title: ID0483863-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/TD4002944716] Charger Output Limited to 51–52 kW
description: Reported behaviour/issue: Customer complain that the charger only provides 51kw power output. the customer tested this this morning at both outlets and maximum output is 52kW.

additional_info.subject: ID0483863-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/TD4002944716] Charger Output Limited to 51–52 kW CRM:02681001619
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
I'm writing to provide you with an update from eMobility Support.
Following a deeper investigation of charger
0AL5U7
logs on March 12
th
between 8:00 and 9:15 CET, I can confirm that no errors are shown or flagged. The power limitations the customer was experiencing were not related to the charger itself. The only limitation at 52kW we encountered originated from EV side, similar to all others power limitations observed during the referred timestamp. And the charger consistently delivered the power requested by the EV.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns. If not, we will close the ticket within 48 hours.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
